title.en: Write Python functions that pass their tests
title.zh: 编写通过测试的 Python 函数

summary.en: The model writes a Python function; an AgentCore Runtime sandbox runs it against the function's tests, and the share of tests passed is the reward. Model-written code never runs in your process, which holds your AWS credentials and the training session.
summary.zh: 模型编写 Python 函数；AgentCore Runtime 沙箱运行函数对应的测试，通过测试的比例即为 reward。模型生成的代码不在本地进程中执行，本地进程持有本机的 AWS 凭证和 training session。

you_will_see.0.en: A fourth block on your side of the loop that runs in AgentCore Runtime, not in this process: its sessions, cold starts and AgentCore cost
you_will_see.0.zh: 循环中新增一个自定义代码节点，它在 AgentCore Runtime 中执行而不是在本地进程中：展示 session 数、冷启动耗时和 AgentCore 费用

you_will_see.1.en: A reward check in the sandbox before the training session exists: correct, wrong and broken functions, one that exits before its tests finish, one that never returns
you_will_see.1.zh: 创建 training session 前，在沙箱中校验 reward：正确、错误和无法运行的函数，测试结束前退出的函数，以及永不返回的函数

you_will_see.2.en: Reward, share of bodies passing every test, share with no result, and the sandbox's cold start per step
you_will_see.2.zh: 逐步查看 reward、通过全部测试的函数体占比、没有结果的函数体占比，以及沙箱冷启动耗时

evidence.note.en: One live run on 2026-11-10 with the defaults (6 steps, 8 functions x 4 answers, one sandbox session per answer). The sandbox side worked: 223 sessions opened and stopped, none throttled, first call p50 1.57 s, 3.8 to 4.9 s of testing per step. Training did not show: the base model already passed almost every test (mean reward 0.98 to 1.0, held-out 8 to 8), and only steps 0 and 2 had groups with a gradient, so the problems need to be harder. Training tokens $0.0144 (matches BillableTokenUsage); AgentCore Runtime $0.0304 for the 223 sessions (usage logs x list price), about twice the tokens. An earlier run that day prompted a plain Python file to continue: gpt-oss-20b wrote prose in all 192 answers, which is why the prompt uses the harmony format.
evidence.note.zh: 2026-11-10 使用默认设置进行一次实时运行（6 步，8 个函数 × 4 个回答，每个回答一个沙箱 session）。沙箱一侧按预期工作：新建并停止 223 个 session，没有被限流，首次调用 p50 1.57 s，每步测试耗时 3.8–4.9 s。训练效果没有显现：基座模型已经能通过几乎所有测试（平均 reward 0.98–1.0，留出集 8 → 8），只有第 0、2 步有产生梯度的组，题目需要更难。训练 token 费用 $0.0144（与 BillableTokenUsage 一致）；223 个 session 的 AgentCore Runtime 费用 $0.0304（用量日志 × 标价），约为 token 费用的 2 倍。同日较早的一次运行让模型续写普通 Python 文件，gpt-oss-20b 的 192 个回答全是文字推理，因此 prompt 改用 harmony 格式。

sandbox.executes.en: The code of each sampled answer and its tests, one microVM per answer (or per group)
sandbox.executes.zh: 每个采样回答中的代码及其测试，每个回答（或每组）一台 microVM

node.forward_backward.out.zh: 梯度保存在 GPU 上

slot.reward.tests_passed.summary.en: passed / total; 0 when the program left no result.
slot.reward.tests_passed.summary.zh: 通过数 / 总数；程序没有输出结果时为 0。

slot.reward.tests_passed.watch.en: Answers that fail some tests still rank above ones that fail all, so more groups give a gradient.
slot.reward.tests_passed.watch.zh: 只通过部分测试的回答，得分仍高于全部失败的回答，因此更多组能产生梯度。

slot.reward.all_pass.summary.en: 1 only when every test passed in time.
slot.reward.all_pass.summary.zh: 仅当所有测试在时限内通过时为 1。

slot.reward.all_pass.watch.en: Groups whose answers all fail at least one test give no gradient.
slot.reward.all_pass.watch.zh: 组内每个回答都至少有一项测试失败时，该组不产生梯度。

slot.reward.exit_code.summary.en: 1 when the test program exits with code 0, as when grading by pytest's exit status.
slot.reward.exit_code.summary.zh: 测试程序以退出码 0 结束时为 1，等同于按 pytest 的退出状态评分。

slot.reward.exit_code.watch.en: The reward check warns: an answer that calls os._exit(0) skips the tests and still scores 1.
slot.reward.exit_code.watch.zh: reward 校验会给出警告：调用 os._exit(0) 的回答跳过了测试，仍然得 1 分。

slot.isolation.rollout.summary.en: Every answer gets a fresh microVM, stopped as soon as it is scored, as MTRL does per rollout.
slot.isolation.rollout.summary.zh: 每个回答使用一台新的 microVM，评分后立即停止，与 MTRL 每条 rollout 一个 session 的做法相同。

slot.isolation.rollout.watch.en: The most sessions and cold starts: prompts x samples per step.
slot.isolation.rollout.watch.zh: session 数和冷启动次数最多：每步为 prompt 数 × 样本数。

slot.isolation.group.summary.en: The answers for one function share a microVM; its work directory is wiped and its processes killed between answers.
slot.isolation.group.summary.zh: 同一函数的各个回答共用一台 microVM；两个回答之间清空工作目录并结束其进程。

slot.isolation.group.watch.en: A quarter of the sessions with 4 samples per prompt; answers of a group run one after another.
slot.isolation.group.watch.zh: 每个 prompt 采样 4 个时，session 数降为四分之一；组内回答依次运行。

param.test_timeout_s.help.en: Code still running after this is killed with its whole process group and scores no result. In a new sandbox version's first sessions a correct solution's test program took up to 4.9 s, and up to 6.0 s later (measured).
param.test_timeout_s.help.zh: 超过此时长仍在运行的代码，会连同其整个进程组被结束，并记为没有结果。沙箱新版本最初的几批 session 中，正确解答的测试程序最长耗时 4.9 s，之后一批最长 6.0 s（实测）。

param.isolation.help.en: One AgentCore Runtime session per answer, or one per group of answers for the same function, wiped between answers.
param.isolation.help.zh: 每个回答一个 AgentCore Runtime session，或同一函数的一组回答共用一个 session，回答之间清空环境。

param.save_checkpoint.label.zh: 保存可恢复训练的 checkpoint

param.save_checkpoint.help.zh: 实测 save_state 耗时 53 s。

param.max_tokens.label.zh: 每个 completion 的最大 token 数

param.max_tokens.help.en: The service minimum is 512. The model reasons briefly before it writes the code; an answer cut off before its code block scores 0.
param.max_tokens.help.zh: 服务允许的最小值为 512。模型先简短推理再写代码；在输出代码块之前被截断的回答得 0 分。

metric.no_result.label.en: Answers with no result (crash, early exit, timeout)
metric.no_result.label.zh: 没有结果的回答（崩溃、提前退出、超时）

events.Correct bodies score above wrong and bro: 正确函数体的得分高于错误和无法运行的函数体
events.Otherwise RL moves the model away from w: 否则，RL 可能使模型更难写出能运行的代码，或无法带来改善。
events.A body that exits before its tests finis: 测试结束前退出的函数体不得分
events.os._exit(0) ends the test program with e: os._exit(0) 会让测试程序在输出结果前以退出码 0 结束：按退出码评分（包括 pytest 的退出码）等于奖励模型跳过测试。
events.A body that never returns is stopped at: 永不返回的函数体在超时后被结束，得 0 分
events.The sandbox kills the whole process grou: 超时后沙箱会结束整个进程组；挂起的函数体不应获得 reward。
events.Not every case scores the same: 不同测试情况的得分不完全相同
events.A constant reward makes every group all-: reward 恒定时，各组内得分全部相同，advantage 为零，无法产生梯度；消耗 token 也不会产生训练效果。
events.Held-out functions whose tests all pass: 测试全部通过的留出函数数
events.Final weights for sampling or deployment: 最终权重，可用于采样或部署
events.Prompts use gpt-oss's harmony chat forma: prompt 使用 gpt-oss 的 harmony 对话格式并设置低推理强度，解答取回答中最后一个 ```python 代码块。实测中让 gpt-oss-20b 续写普通 Python 文件时，192 个 completion 全部是文字推理而不是代码（实时运行，2026-11-10）。
events.Held-out functions, greedy answers: base: 留出函数上的贪心解码：对比基座模型与训练后模型
